lines:
Feature: tell the user when a model finishes.
Part A — Aworkit is not in the foreground: show an OS/desktop notification (Windows taskbar/app-icon surface). Plumbing already exists: `native_notify` command (`main.rs:121`) → `presentation::show_notification` using `tauri-plugin-notification` (`presentation.rs:157-167`), and `defaultAdapters.ts:18` calls it only when `document.hidden`. Extend this so completion of a background Chat raises an OS notification whenever the app window is not focused (not only when the document is hidden), with a useful title/body.
Part B — Aworkit is focused but the Chat is not the active one: the history list currently swaps the running spinner for a plain `○` as soon as `busy` is false (`NavigationPane.tsx:296-302`). Instead the row must show a green blinking icon after a Run completes elsewhere, until that Chat is made active.
Implementation notes (researched): per-Chat completion is observable from `snapshot.activeChatIds` transitions (`concurrency.rs:17-25`, `service/concurrent.rs:112`); there is no persisted unread field (`ChatHistoryEntry` types.ts:50-62). Track unread Chat ids in the shell (frontend session state), set one when a Chat leaves `activeChatIds` while not selected, and clear it when the Chat is selected (`App.tsx:285-289`). Add a `.chat-unread-icon` style to `styles.css` beside `.chat-busy-icon` (552-566) with a reduced-motion fallback.
Answer the user's question in the final report: Tauri's OS abstraction for this is the official Notification plugin (`tauri-plugin-notification`), which shows a native toast/notification; there is no cross-platform taskbar-badge API, so the plugin is the supported surface. Verify OS notification capability is granted.
Verification: frontend unit test for the unread-transition logic and the icon rendering; keep native notification test script out of scope.

data.title: Notify on Chat completion: OS notification when unfocused and a green blinking unread icon in the history list
